title: 5 plugins every vibe coder needs before shipping
description:
Five plugins that catch what AI coding gets wrong: Playwright so your assistant tests the page in a real browser, the official Supabase server for databases from the terminal, Strix to attack your own app and close the security holes, Chrome DevTools to pull any site's design system into one file, and Context7 for current library documentation instead of outdated guesses.

Every exact install command plus the security guardrails: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Ui3GNsS_zH0z53OeKlTNVeEmTf7j2TL5p6Oejv2GG-8/edit?usp=sharing
